description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching and processing OECD Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, including query parameter validation, data extraction from an API, and data transformation.

classes.name: OECDCPIQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for OECD CPI data requests, including validation and schema customization.

classes.name: OECDCPIData
classes.description: Represents the CPI data fetched from OECD, extending the base ConsumerPriceIndexData.

classes.name: OECDCPIFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing OECD CPI data based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated OECDCPIQueryParams object, setting default date range and country if missing.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw CPI data from OECD API, applies filters, and formats the data into a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data into a list of OECDCPIData objects, sorted by date.
